coverage.note: Table project_types renamed to workspaces, projects.project_type renamed to workspace_id; /api/project-types became /api/workspaces in src/server.ts; the UI renamed in public/index.html and public/app.js. ProjectRecord.type keeps its field name because it is the peer replication wire field (see code-summary.md, Deviations).

migrateWorkspaceSchema only renames the table and column; the directory-name derivation in src/managed-home.ts still uses the workspace id, which never changed. Asserted by "the workspaces rename moves no directory on disk".
ALTER TABLE RENAME preserves every row; asserted by "renaming project types to workspaces keeps ids, labels and project membership".
projects.workspace_id is a single NOT NULL column, as projects.project_type was.
saveWorkspace upserts on id and only replaces the label; asserted by the rename case in "workspaces seed personal and work...".
src/github-auth.ts deleted; dropLegacyGitHubSchema drops all nine github_* tables; the /api/github-auth* routes are removed from src/server.ts.
githubGroupDialog, githubSyncDialog, the project-type group picker and projectGithubDialog removed; asserted by test/secrets-ui.test.ts "the GitHub credential group surfaces are gone".
applyGitHubEnvironment reads the already-resolved variable map; resolution itself has no provider branch.
The four-tier chain is deleted with github-auth.ts; resolved() implements the three-tier merge.
SecretScopeType is workspace|project|conversation; asserted by "secret assignments accept the three scope types and reject anything else".
conversationScopeId(engine, sessionId) produces `${engine}:${sessionId}`, the identity conversation-ownership.ts already uses.
scopeRows only returns attached accounts; asserted by the inertness case in "secret accounts redact saved values...".
secret_assignments PRIMARY KEY(scope_type, scope_id, account_id) allows one account at many scopes and entities.
secret_assignments stores account_id only; variables live once, in secret_accounts.
resolved() returns workspace, then project, then conversation; genericSecretEnvironment writes per variable name in that order.
Asserted by "resolution is most-specific-wins per variable name across the three scopes".
The ONLY_WORKSPACE assertion in the same test.
OQ1 resolved as D8: assertNoCollision rejects the ambiguity at attachment time, at all three tiers, so it cannot be created.
assertInput forces a github account to hold exactly one GH_TOKEN value; the UI never offers the name.
applyGitHubEnvironment fans one token to GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN and PI_GITHUB_TOKEN; asserted by "a GitHub token produces the whole git push contract".
ensureAskPassHelper writes the same helper github-auth.ts wrote, reading PI_GITHUB_TOKEN, and GIT_ASKPASS points at it.
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is set to "0" alongside GIT_ASKPASS, as before.
applyGitHubEnvironment returns early with no token, so the helper is not written; asserted by the withoutToken block.
Marker table secrets_migrations, key github-groups-v1, following the per-module convention.
createGitHubAccount per group, labelled with the group's label; asserted by the account-label list in "the migration converts groups into accounts".
workspaces.github_group becomes a workspace-scoped attachment.
github_project_auth.account becomes a project-scoped attachment.
github_project_auth.token becomes its own project-scoped account, which wins as the override did.
workspaceResolvesToken gates the default account so it backfills only workspaces resolving nothing.
The migration reads only local tables and writes only local rows; there is no cross-node step, so each node converts its own replicated copy in place.
"every project resolves the same GitHub token after the migration as before it" checks all four resolution tiers of the old chain.
secret_accounts.replicate column, exposed on the API and as the secret-account-replicate-toggle in the UI; POST /api/secrets/sync pushes them.
refreshOutbox enqueues only replicate = 1 and deletes events for accounts switched back; asserted by two tests.
receiveSecretCredentialEvents re-encrypts with the local key; asserted by "a received account is re-encrypted locally".
A local save bumps updated_at to now, which outranks the peer version by the (updatedAt, originNodeId) comparison; asserted in the same test.
replicate defaults to 0 in the DDL and saveSecretAccount; asserted by the account.replicate === false check.
rekeySecretAssignments is called from rekeyProjectState in src/store.ts, fixing the defect at the old store.ts:249.
removeProject deletes project-scoped rows for the canonical id and every alias; asserted by the lifecycle test.
deleteWorkspace deletes workspace-scoped rows in the same transaction; asserted by the lifecycle test.
deleteSecretAccount deletes by account_id at every scope; asserted by "deleting an account removes its attachments".
scopeRows joins secret_accounts so a dangling row yields nothing, and the workspace tier reads workspace_id without validating it; asserted in the same test.
openSecretScope renders a checkbox per existing account and is used at all three levels.
workspace-secrets-button on each workspace row in Settings > Projects.
project-secrets-button in the project row overflow menu.
conversation-secrets-list in the new-conversation dialog; the ids travel on the socket as secretAccountIds and src/server.ts persists them once the engine reports a session id.
persistConversationSecretAccounts only writes rows; no spawn site is restarted, and the doc comment states the behaviour.
Each scope dialog is titled with its scope and entity and shows a checked box per attached account, which unchecking detaches.
publicAccount strips values; asserted end-to-end by "every secrets endpoint returns metadata only".

encryptSecretValue/decryptSecretValue keep AES-256-GCM under the node's secret.key; secretFilePath keeps 0600 files inside a 0700 directory; test/audit.test.ts asserts no plaintext reaches the database, the WAL or an audit event.
Every account and scope response body is asserted not to contain the fixture value.
"a node-local account produces no outbound replication row".
The repeated-resolution assertion in "secret accounts redact saved values...".
"the migration is marker-gated and a second run changes nothing" snapshots accounts and assignments across a second run.
Full suite green: 450/450 before, 446/446 after. Tests for the removed GitHub credential group model were deleted with it; see code-summary.md.

POST /api/cluster/github/events is a 410-returning stub for older peers, and validateEvent rejects a malformed batch before the transaction writes anything; asserted by "malformed peer input is rejected rather than half-applied".
